contexts: Rural catchment with long travel distances
Five-month wait for first physiotherapy appointment
Video and in-person six-week classes with the same content
Routine KOOS-12, chair stand and attendance data
reading: Travel is the main barrier to in-person classes, and video delivery removes it for people with a device, a connection and confidence. Trials show similar pain outcomes, but they mostly excluded the people the service worries about. Completion and uptake depend on broadband, age and language, so the programme could help most people while leaving a digitally excluded group behind. The quantitative strand tells the service whether outcomes are in the expected range; the qualitative strand explains who stops and why.
